findings.title: Carry exact topic qualifications into new public connection messages
findings.description: Generic tag messages discard the saved tag meaning and qualifiedExplanation and direct the student to conditions below. Five new connections have no public summary: Work Ethic award-a4379bfbc7bd healthcare, public_service, agriculture_conservation and stem, plus Junior College/Trade School award-a4ca14a7716d female. Thus the exact saved limitations do not reach proposed student-facing copy. For example Work Ethic healthcare support is associate/LPN nursing and veterinary technology, not four-year nursing or all healthcare, and its STEM support is approved programs of two years or less. A generic non-eligibility disclaimer does not retain those award-specific qualifications required by scope section5.
findings.requestedChange: Use readable evidence-bound qualification text for the proposed new tag connections, especially the five without summaries. Keep existing public fields, eligibility and original connections unchanged; add a regression confirming exact qualifications remain present even when summary is null.
findings.resolution: Five new null-summary connections now carry exact readable approved-program and transportation/chapter qualifications, independently checked against saved source evidence.

findings.title: Explicitly route changed existing criteria to later policy selection
findings.description: The nine applied J/K deltas across eight existing awards are retained as raw field evidence, but the reconciliation has no explicit field-level conflict disposition with owner, trigger and next action. Scope4 requires conflicting existing eligibility/shortlist criteria to be recorded for explicit later policy selection while preserving accepted behavior. NATA J110, Montana STEM K169, Horatio K30, Elks K21 and Presidential J101 differ from the preserved shortlist. Work Ethic, Junior College/Trade School and Allegra school deltas already agree with current shortlist despite historical public eligibility differences; Horatio J30 already agrees with unknown shortlist GPA. Raw deltas alone do not distinguish these outcomes or establish follow-up.
findings.requestedChange: Record explicit per-field preserved/conflicting outcomes for all nine existing J/K deltas, pin both preserved public/shortlist behavior and the current organizer evidence, and give actual conflicts an owner, separately selected policy trigger and concrete next action. Preserve all existing decisions and fields.
findings.resolution: All nine existing J/K deltas now have evidence-bound field dispositions: five actual shortlist conflicts route to Kelsey for separate policy selection; four agreements preserve existing publications and route to regression checks.
